desc_en: A tight, POV vertical run through Skopje Old Bazaar: pick produce, pay, and step out into the stone streets. One consistent hero (same hands/clothes) and one clear process, with local textures and light—no generic stock aisle look, no readable signage.
music: Upbeat lo-fi hip hop with Balkan percussion accents, 118–122 bpm, warm and punchy
vo_mk: Влегувам во чаршија, знам што барам.
Ги бирам најсвежите домати и пиперки.
Пет минути — и свежо од чаршија.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16, photorealistic POV from chest height of one shopper in Skopje Old Bazaar, only their forearms visible in a simple beige jacket with rolled sleeves, holding a plain reusable cloth bag. Narrow stone alley with warm stone walls and blurred stalls, no readable text, no logos. 24mm lens, natural morning light, warm earthy palette, shallow depth to keep background soft.
shots.motion: The shopper’s left hand opens the cloth bag while the right hand reaches toward a produce crate; camera gently pushes forward with a natural walking bob, stabilised but human, over 5 seconds.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16, photorealistic close POV at a wooden produce stand: the same beige sleeves and hands selecting red tomatoes and green peppers from a rustic crate, placing them into the same cloth bag. Background shows soft bokeh of bazaar textures—stone, wicker, metal bowls—without any readable signage. 35mm lens, crisp focus on hands and produce, warm sunlight, subtle shadows.
shots.motion: One clear action: the right hand picks two tomatoes and drops them into the open bag. Camera does a small right-to-left slide, keeping the hands centered, smooth and plausible in 5 seconds.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16, photorealistic medium POV at a small market counter: the same shopper’s hands hold a few coins above an old wooden surface; a vendor’s hands (face not shown) accept the payment and pass back change. No readable text, no logos, simple background blur of produce and hanging sacks. 50mm lens, soft morning light, warm neutral palette, clear skin tones, unambiguous fingers.
shots.motion: The shopper places coins into the vendor’s palm; the vendor returns change into the shopper’s hand. Camera makes a gentle downward tilt to follow the exchange, steady and natural over 5 seconds.
